format: mp3 (libmp3lame CBR, 48 kHz, LAME/Xing header with encoder delay + padding)

notes.volume: `volume` is the linear gain the game passes when it plays the clip (first call site); `volume_notes` lists the other call sites or the formula for clips the game drives continuously. The bus gain (options master * per-bus slider) multiplies on top.
notes.loops: Loops: the decoded buffer should be exactly `samples` long. If a browser ignores the LAME gapless header the buffer comes back longer; then set loopStart = 1105 / sample_rate (LAME's encoder delay), loopEnd = loopStart + duration.
notes.crossfade: AMB_CrowdLow and AMB_CrowdHigh are uncorrelated: use an equal-power cross-fade
notes.voice: Announcer and field vocals use saved Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-CustomVoice performances (Ryan preset). See Audio/make_takes.py.

files.name: SFX_BallAir
volume_notes: loop 0.18 + 0.27 * approach, pitch 0.94 + 0.28 * approach, while a pass is in the air

files.name: SFX_FuryLoop
volume_notes: loop 0.45 while either team is in Fury (fade in 4/s, out 2.5/s)

files.name: AMB_Chant
volume_notes: loop 0.42 on a big down (lineup / pre-snap)
